name: cancelling_a_return_twice
use_case: Return status inquiry and duplicate prevention
branch: Customer cancels an authorized return authorization R470 on delivered order O476; a repeated request returns the same cancellation idempotently
tests: the agent cancels Ananya Iyer's authorized return R470 after confirmation, voiding the return label and returning the item units to held status
instruction:
You have an authorized return R470 for your Relaxed Fit Chino Trousers (AP06) from order O476. You want to cancel the return authorization so you can keep the trousers. When asked for confirmation, confirm that you want to cancel the return.

Your details:
- Name: Ananya Iyer
- Email: ananya.iyer@example.in
- Postal Code: 560001
- Order ID: O476
- Return ID: R470

persona.name: Ananya Iyer
persona.initial_message: Hello, I previously initiated a return R470 for my trousers from order O476, but I decided to keep them. Please cancel return R470.
